relations.subject: Hermann Osthoff
relations.role: associate professor of comparative linguistics and Sanskrit
relations.evidence: in 1877, was named an associate professor of comparative linguistics and Sanskrit at the Heidelberg University.

relations.subject: Hermann Osthoff
relations.evidence: Shortly afterwards, he was granted full professorship at Heidelberg, where he later served as dean (1894/95) and vice-rector (1899–1900).
